verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not show Drata producing AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. The AI-related items (drata-docs-2 and the MCP server in drata-probe-4) describe external AI agents connecting to Drata and managing controls through natural language, which is a separate capability. In-product features such as Risk Assessment and the Trust Center Analytics Dashboard are listed without any mention of AI-generated insights or recommendations.
